# coolify_notification_telegram (Resource)

Manages the current team's Telegram notification settings in Coolify. This is a team-scoped singleton (one configuration per team, selected by the API token). **Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0** (notification routes are absent on v4.2.x and older; acceptance tests skip when the API is missing).

On destroy, Telegram notifications are disabled (`enabled = false`); token, chat ID, and thread IDs are left unchanged. Import with id `current`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Team Telegram notification settings (Coolify >= v4.3.0).
# Import: terraform import coolify_notification_telegram.main current
resource "coolify_notification_telegram" "main" {
  enabled = true
  token   = "0000000000:replace-with-bot-token"
  chat_id = "-1000000000000"

  deployment_failure = true
  backup_failure     = true
  server_disk_usage  = true
  server_unreachable = true

  # Optional forum topic thread IDs (sensitive).
  # thread_deployment_failure = "123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `backup_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for backup failure events.
- `backup_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for backup success events.
- `chat_id` (String, Sensitive) Telegram chat ID. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `deployment_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for deployment failure events.
- `deployment_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for deployment success events.
- `docker_cleanup_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for Docker cleanup failure events.
- `docker_cleanup_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for Docker cleanup success events.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are enabled for the team.
- `scheduled_task_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for scheduled task failure events.
- `scheduled_task_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for scheduled task success events.
- `server_disk_usage` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for server disk usage events.
- `server_patch` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for server patch events.
- `server_reachable` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for server reachable events.
- `server_unreachable` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for server unreachable events.
- `status_change` (Boolean) Whether to send Telegram notifications for status change events.
- `thread_backup_failure` (String, Sensitive) Telegram forum thread ID for backup_failure events. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Always `current` (team is implied by the API token).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import coolify_notification_telegram.main current
```
